Kai Nguyen: Quick flag — weekly KPI deck shows Paid CPA improving by 22% vs last week, but Last-Touch vs First-Touch are telling different stories. feels like we're arguing about math, not performance :thinking_face:
Maya Tran: yep saw the slide. deck uses last-touch by default, our dashboard exposes first-touch. that's probably why the PMs are confused when I call out channel wins
Evan Cole: ouch. last-touch will always favor bottom-of-funnel partners (retargeting), first-touch favors top-of-funnel. we should pick one canonical definition for weekly execs
Priya Shah: can we consider a time-decay model for launches? it captures multi-touch contribution without flipping stories every week.
Kai Nguyen: agree time-decay makes sense for launch narratives, but it's heavier to compute and less familiar to some stakeholders
Tom B: operationally low lift: add a small badge on the KPI slide that says "Attribution: last-touch (deck) vs first-touch (dashboard)" and link to the canonical doc. longer term we can add the time-decay series as an optional overlay
data-bot: Info: attribution-run job completed 2026-03-28T14:02:11Z. run_id=attr-20260328-14. rows=9,842,113
Maya Tran: to move faster — propose we standardize: weekly exec deck = time-decay(7d, half-life 2d) for launches + a short appendix with last-touch and first-touch tables. Thoughts?
Evan Cole: sounds reasonable. time-decay(7d) will give credit to earlier discovery events but still favors recent touchpoints — good for launch lifecycle
Priya Shah: i'm +1 but want a simple explainer slide showing how numbers change. marketing partners keep asking "why did my channel drop" — need transparency
Kai Nguyen: agree. also include a tiny worked example on the explainer slide. e.g., "User X touched via social (day 0), email (day 3), retarget (day 5) -> time-decay weights -> attribution share = social 0.45 / email 0.30 / retarget 0.25"
Maya Tran: can someone give me the SQL or psuedocode for the time-decay so the analytics team can reproduce? I'll paste it on the doc.
Evan Cole: quick pseudocode i used in sandbox:
```-- pseudo
WITH events AS (
  SELECT user_id, event_time, channel
  FROM touchpoints
  WHERE event_time BETWEEN launch_date AND launch_date + interval '14 days'
), weights AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, exp(-extract(epoch from (max(event_time)-event_time))/ (2*86400.0)) as w
  FROM events
  GROUP BY user_id, channel, event_time
)
SELECT channel, sum(w)/sum(sum(w)) over () as contribution_pct
FROM weights
GROUP BY channel;
```
Maya Tran: that's great. include that and the half-life explanation in the doc. we'll need a short-run validation vs last-touch for the May launch
Tom B: i can add a toggle on pulseboard to surface the time-decay series (staging first). small UI: radio: [last-touch | first-touch | time-decay]

Kai Nguyen: please include sample size (N MQLs) and CI so PMs don't overreact to noisy channels with small N
